$comment: The Claude Code plugins modules can bring; each is turned on in .claude/settings.json `enabledPlugins`. Each entry says where it comes from and where it goes: `install` (a command), `copy` (a file or folder in library/, copied whole) or `template` (a file in template/, which Copier renders and merges with the project's edits), and `output` (the path, or paths, it writes in the project). An install runs when one of its outputs is missing; outputs go when no module needs the entry any more. An entry with no source is written by another entry's `install` (its output is in that entry's `output`). `frameworks` (if any) lists the frameworks it fits; elsewhere it is left out.

superpowers@claude-plugins-official.describe: process skills (brainstorming, plans, test-driven development, subagents) the feature workflow uses.
